ticks.note: Tick 1 enters S. Its only transition is a delayed self-loop, so nothing is computed yet and lit holds the rounded literal 0.10000000149011612.

The input F is the double 0.1, but the literal 0.1 is rounded to single precision (0.10000000149011612): F == 0.1 is false and F < 0.1 is true. lit was initialised from the same rounded literal, so lit == 0.1 is true. F * 4 == 0.4 is false too.
0.5 is exact in single precision: F < 0.1 is false; F * 4 == 0.4 is still false (2 versus 0.4).
